BusinessName.BusinessNameLine1Txt: SAN DIEGO REGIONAL CHAMBER OF COMMERCE

IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: PROVIDE SERVICES THAT WILL PROMOTE A POSITIVE AND BALANCED BUSINESS CLIMATE IN SAN DIEGO
IRS990.MissionDesc: IT IS THE MISSION OF THE SAN DIEGO REGIONAL CHAMBER OF COMMERCE TO BE THE LEADING, MOST EFFECTIVE ADVOCATE AND VOICE FOR BUSINESS POLICY AND CONNECTIONS IN THE SAN DIEGO-BAJA CALIFORNIA REGION.
IRS990.Desc: PROVIDE SERVICES AND EVENTS THAT WILL PROMOTE A POSITIVE BUSINESS CLIMATE IN THE SAN DIEGO, CA REGION.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: OPERATE PROGRAMS PRIMARILY TO HELP SMALL BUSINESS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SAN DIEGO REGIONAL CHAMBER OF COMMERCE WORKED TO ENGAGE ELECTED OFFICIALS, PUBLIC AGENCIES AND THEIR STAFFS TO HELP BUSINESSES UNDERSTAND AND COMPLY WITH LEGISLATION THAT INCLUDED CHANGING REGULATIONS THAT IMPACT OPERATIONS SUCH AS PERMITTING, LEASES, TARIFFS; INCREASING HOUSING SUPPLY; PUBLIC SAFETY POLICY; AND REGIONAL AND CROSS-BORDER WORKFORCE NEEDS. THIS WORK WAS DONE VIA MEETINGS, TESTIMONY AT PUBLIC MEETINGS, LETTERS, AND SOCIAL MEDIA. THE CHAMBER STAFF ALSO EDUCATED MEMBERS VIA REGULAR EMAILS AND COMMITTEE MEETINGS ABOUT POLICIES THAT WERE BOTH PROPOSED AND PUT INTO EFFECT.

THE ORGANIZATION IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL INCOME TAX UNDER THE PROVISIONS OF SECTION 501(C)(6) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE AND IS ALSO EXEMPT FROM STATE TAXES. THE ORGANIZATION, FROM TIME TO TIME, MAY RECEIVE UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME, WHICH IS SUBJECT TO INCOME TAXES AT REGULAR CORPORATE TAX RATES. DURING THE YEARS ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024 AND 2023, THERE WAS NO UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME FOR THE ORGANIZATION. IN ADDITION, THE ORGANIZATION IS SUBJECT TO A PROXY TAX WHEN ITS POLITICAL EXPENDITURES ARE IN EXCESS OF THE MEMBERSHIP DUES REPORTED TO ITS MEMBERSHIP AS NONDEDUCTIBLE BUSINESS EXPENSES. DURING THE YEARS ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024 AND 2023, THE CHAMBER DID NOT INCUR A PROXY TAX WITH RESPECT TO THESE EXPENDITURES. ALL TAX-EXEMPT ENTITIES ARE SUBJECT TO REVIEW AND AUDIT BY FEDERAL, STATE, AND OTHER APPLICABLE AGENCIES. SUCH AGENCIES MAY REVIEW THE TAXABILITY OF UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME, OR THE QUALIFICATION OF THE ORGANIZATION AS A TAX-EXEMPT ENTITY UNDER INTERNAL REVENUE CODE SECTION 501(C)(6) AND APPLICABLE STATE STATUTES. AS OF DECEMBER 31, 2024, THE ORGANIZATION HAS NOT BEEN NOTIFIED OF ANY SUCH AUDIT OR REVIEW. THE FOUNDATION IS A NON-PROFIT CORPORATION ORGANIZED UNDER THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA AND IS EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAXES UNDER SECTION 501(C)(3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE AND SECTION 23701(D) OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE. LEAD SAN DIEGO, INC IS A NON-PROFIT CORPORATION ORGANIZED UNDER THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA AND IS EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAXES UNDER SECTION 501(C)(3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE AND SECTION 23701(D) OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE. THE ORGANIZATION DOES NOT HAVE ANY UNRECOGNIZED TAX BENEFITS AT DECEMBER 31, 2024 AND 2023. THE ORGANIZATION RECOGNIZES INTEREST AND PENALTIES ASSOCIATED WITH TAX MATTERS AS PART OF OPERATING EXPENSES AND INCLUDES ACCRUED INTEREST AND PENALTIES WITH THE RELATED TAX LIABILITY IN THE CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF FINANCIAL POSITION. NO SUCH AMOUNTS ARE INCLUDED IN THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FOR THE YEARS ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024 AND 2023.

THE CEO RECEIVES A $1,000 PER MONTH CAR ALLOWANCE UNDER AN ACCOUNTABLE PLAN. ALL EMPLOYEES RECEIVE A MEMBERSHIP TO A LOCAL HEALTH CLUB IF THEY USE THE FACILITY EIGHT OR MORE TIMES A MONTH. IF THEY DO NOT USE THE FACILITY EIGHT OR MORE TIMES A MONTH, THE COMPANY DOES NOT REIMBURSE CLUB MEMBERSHIP FOR THAT MONTH. COST IS APPROXIMATELY $59/MO.
YES, COMMISSION/BONUSES ARE EARNED BASED ON REVENUE RECEIVED. SHERMAN STOCKER AND ROBERT HACKEN BOTH RECEIVED COMPENSATION CONTINGENT ON THE REVENUE RECEIVED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 6
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION HAS 2 CLASSES OF MEMBERS: VOTING AND NONVOTING

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE VOTING MEMBERS HAVE THE RIGHT TO VOTE, AND THE NONVOTING DO NOT. THE MANAGEMENT COUNCIL'S PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES ARE (I) OVERSIGHT OF THE BUSINESS AND OPERATIONS OF THE CHAMBER, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION THE POWER TO LEVY DUES AND ASSESSMENTS, TO SELECT AND REMOVE ALL OFFICERS, AGENTS, EMPLOYEES AND CONTRACTORS, AND TO FIX REASONABLE COMPENSATION THEREFOR, TO AUTHORIZE AND EMPOWER OFFICERS OR AGENTS TO ENTER INTO CONTRACTS AND OTHER COMMITMENTS ON BEHALF OF THE CHAMBER, AND (II) SETTING THE AGENDA FOR THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. WITH CERTAIN LIMITED EXCEPTIONS, ALL RIGHTS, PRIVILEGES AND POWERS CONFERRED BY LAW OR BY THE BYLAWS UPON THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS ARE VESTED IN THE MANAGEMENT COUNCIL. THE CHAIR OF THE BOARD IS THE CHAIR OF THE MANAGEMENT COUNCIL, WHO SHALL HAVE THE POWER TO CALL MEETINGS OF THE MANAGEMENT COUNCIL AND WHO PRESIDES AT ALL MEETINGS OF THE MANAGEMENT COUNCIL. THE OTHER MEMBERS OF THE MANAGEMENT COUNCIL ARE THE VICE CHAIR OF THE BOARD, THE IMMEDIATE PAST CHAIR OF THE BOARD (UNLESS HE OR SHE IS UNABLE OR UNWILLING TO SERVE), THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER; THE CHAIR FOR PUBLIC POLICY, THE TREASURER AND CHAIR FOR FINANCE; AND FOUR CHAIRS AT-LARGE. MINUTES OF THE MEETINGS OF THE MANAGEMENT COUNCIL ARE KEPT IN THE SAME MANNER AS IN THE BYLAWS PROVIDED FOR THE KEEPING OF MINUTES OF THE MEETINGS OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: MANAGEMENT SENDS THE COMPLETED DOCUMENT TO THE GOVERNING BODY AND VARIOUS COMMITTEES PRIOR TO FILING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ALL NEW OFFICERS, DIRECTORS, TRUSTEES, AND KEY EMPLOYEES ARE REQUIRED TO SUBMIT THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST QUESTIONNAIRE, AND ANNUALLY ARE REQUESTED TO DISCLOSE ANY CHANGES. IN ADDITION, MANAGEMENT REGULARLY REVIEWS BUSINESS TRANSACTIONS TO DETERMINE IF ANY PERCEIVED CONFLICT MAY EXIST.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: CEO COMPENSATION IS REVIEWED PRIOR TO THE RENEWAL OF THE CONTRACT AND ALSO AT THE END OF EACH YEAR, AS THERE IS TYPICALLY A CLAUSE IN THE CONTRACT THAT APPLIES TO ANNUAL INCREASES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION'S GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, AND AUDITED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST.
THE ORGANIZATION'S PROCESSES FOR OVERSIGHT OF THE AUDIT OF ITS FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SELECTION OF AN INDEPENDENT ACCOUNTANT HAVE NOT CHANGED FROM THE PREVIOUS YEAR
